# Vectraa

> Vectraa is a free, private, browser-based image-to-SVG vector converter. Core conversion runs on the visitor's device. Images and SVGs are not uploaded. No account and no watermark are required.

## Converter pages

- [Image to SVG](https://vectraa.com/image-to-svg): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP artwork to genuine SVG paths.
- [Image to vector online free](https://vectraa.com/image-to-vector): Free online image-to-vector conversion with no account.
- [PNG to SVG](https://vectraa.com/png-to-svg): Convert transparent PNG logos, icons, and artwork.
- [PNG to SVG, no upload](https://vectraa.com/png-to-svg-no-upload): Trace a PNG in the browser without uploading it.
- [PNG to SVG for Cricut](https://vectraa.com/png-to-svg-for-cricut): Prepare a high-contrast PNG as SVG paths for cutting.
- [JPG to SVG](https://vectraa.com/jpg-to-svg): Convert JPEG artwork with cleanup for compression noise.
- [WebP to SVG](https://vectraa.com/webp-to-svg): Convert WebP graphics to scalable SVG paths.
- [Logo vectorizer](https://vectraa.com/logo-vectorizer): Restore and vectorize logo artwork.
- [Convert logo to SVG](https://vectraa.com/convert-logo-to-svg): Convert a raster logo to SVG paths.
- [Signature to SVG](https://vectraa.com/signature-to-svg): Trace a scanned signature with the signature preset.
- [Line art vectorizer](https://vectraa.com/line-art-vectorizer): Convert drawings, outlines, and signatures.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://vectraa.com/privacy): Images never leave the browser for basic conversion.
- [About](https://vectraa.com/about): What Vectraa is and how to start.

## Product facts

- Generates SVG geometry rather than wrapping a raster image inside SVG.
- Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP inputs up to 20 MB.
- Includes adaptive best-of-three tracing, Logo Rescue, before/after comparison, vector health checks, and purpose-aware export guidance.
- Core conversion is processed locally in the browser. The image is not uploaded.
- No account and no watermark are required for basic conversion.
